name: DVG_Sprint5_ERP_Rechnungserfassung_Bot
description:
Create a UiPath Studio Web browser automation for Sprint 5 / Vorgang 3: "UiPath-Bot zur automatisierten ERP-Erfassung implementieren".
Goal:
Automate the manual ERP invoice entry process on this website:
https://anhe0003.github.io/this-and-that/ERP_Rechnungserfassung.html
Build one clear main workflow/sequence named:
DVG_Sprint5_ERP_Rechnungserfassung_Bot
Important:
Use the currently visible ERP page only.
Do not use old fields.
Do not use invoiceId.
Do not use IBAN.
Do not use amountGross.
Do not use "Rechnung erfassen".
Do not use "Erfolg!" success alert.
Do not type into calculated fields like Netto, Steuer, Brutto, Gesamt Netto, Gesamt Steuer or Gesamt Brutto.
The actual visible page contains these fields:
- Rechnungsnummer
- Rechnungsdatum
- Lieferantenname
- Kundennummer
- Zahlungsziel
- Bemerkungen
- Rechnungsposten table:
  - Beschreibung
  - Menge
  - Einheit
  - Einzelpreis (Netto)
  - Steuer (%)
- Button "+ Neue Rechnung"
- Button "Rechnung speichern / aktualisieren"
- Sidebar/List "Rechnungen"
Use browser automation with stable label-based selectors.
Use normal Type Into or Set Value activities.
Clear each field before typing.
Use these fixed test data variables at the beginning of the workflow:
- invoiceNumber = "RE-2024-001"
- invoiceDate = "10.01.2024"
- supplierName = "Mustermann GmbH"
- customerNumber = "K-001"
- paymentTerms = "14 Tage netto"
- comment = "Automatisch durch UiPath erfasst."
- positionDescription = "Musterleistung"
- quantity = "1"
- unit = "Stk."
- unitPriceNet = "840.34"
Workflow requirements:
1. Open the ERP frontend
- Open the URL:
  https://anhe0003.github.io/this-and-that/ERP_Rechnungserfassung.html
- Use Edge or Chrome.
- Maximize the browser window if possible.
2. Wait until the form is ready
- Use "Check App State" or an equivalent activity.
- Wait until the page title "ERP – Rechnungserfassung" or the section "Rechnungsdaten" is visible.
- Timeout: 10 seconds.
- If the form is not visible after the timeout, throw an exception:
  "ERP-Formular wurde nicht geladen."
3. Start a new invoice
- Click the button "+ Neue Rechnung" if it is visible.
4. Fill all invoice header fields
Use "Set Value" or "Type Into" with "clear field before typing" enabled.
Fill:
- Field "Rechnungsnummer" with variable invoiceNumber
- Field "Rechnungsdatum" with variable invoiceDate
- Field "Lieferantenname" with variable supplierName
- Field "Kundennummer" with variable customerNumber
- Field "Zahlungsziel" with variable paymentTerms
- Field "Bemerkungen" with variable comment
5. Fill the first invoice position row
The page already contains one editable row in the "Rechnungsposten" table.
Do not click calculated fields.
Do not type into Netto, Steuer, Brutto or totals.
Fill only:
- Column "Beschreibung" with variable positionDescription
- Column "Menge" with variable quantity
- Column "Einheit" with variable unit
- Column "Einzelpreis (Netto)" with variable unitPriceNet
- Leave "Steuer (%)" at default 19 %
6. Save the invoice
- Click the button "Rechnung speichern / aktualisieren".
7. Check success
After saving, check whether the invoice number "RE-2024-001" appears in the left sidebar/list under "Rechnungen".
If "RE-2024-001" appears:
- Log message:
  "ERP-Erfassung erfolgreich abgeschlossen."
- Take a screenshot.
If "RE-2024-001" does not appear:
- Throw exception:
  "ERP-Speicherung fehlgeschlagen: Rechnung erscheint nicht in der Rechnungsliste."
8. Error handling
Wrap the browser automation in Try/Catch.
In the Catch block:
- Log the exception message.
- Take an error screenshot.
- End the workflow with failed status.
9. Final structure
The generated workflow should be easy to understand and demonstrate:
- Assign variables
- Open ERP page
- Wait for form
- Click "+ Neue Rechnung"
- Fill invoice header fields
- Fill first invoice position row
- Click "Rechnung speichern / aktualisieren"
- Check invoice appears in "Rechnungen"
- Screenshot/log result
- Error handling
The automation must be suitable for a Sprint Review demo.
It should run the full Happy Path without manual input after starting the bot.
